minutes.headline: Superintendent proposed a school budget up about 6%; members urged asking for more, including paraprofessionals.
minutes.summary: The committee heard a line transfer, the superintendent's report, and a plan to bid asbestos abatement now with options. The superintendent presented her recommended FY2016 budget, and members said it was not generous and urged a higher request. They also discussed the TC Passios parcel boundaries, approved the Quebec trip and gifts, and took policy readings.

what_happened.line: The superintendent presented a recommended FY2016 school budget, and members said it was not generous and urged a higher request.
Members indicated the superintendent should update the budget to add five more paraprofessionals.
The committee agreed to bid the earlier asbestos abatement appropriation now, with alternates for the remaining work.
The committee agreed to seek a joint meeting with the reuse committee and to transfer the minimum TC Passios parcel.
The committee approved the Quebec trip, accepted two gifts and took policy readings; the minutes record these votes as not audible.

why_it_matters: The budget the committee sends on sets the school share of the town's request, so a higher ask for staff such as paraprofessionals would bear on the tax bill and on classroom support.
The TC Passios parcel line affects how much land is available for reuse and development, and the asbestos bid decides how much of that work is done with the money already appropriated.
watch_next: An updated FY2016 school budget that adds the paraprofessional positions.
A joint meeting with the reuse committee on the TC Passios parcel.
